verdict.rationale: Glama's pricing page directly claims that users can 'Automate workflows using schedules or webhooks,' which matches the story's recurring, autonomous background execution. That single line is the only evidence: no docs describe how automations are built, triggered, monitored or run, and there is no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: dedicated documentation of how to create and configure automations, details on schedule and trigger options, evidence of background execution and monitoring or logs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
